headline: TOR @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 2.50 at ATL 4.51, with a projected total of 7.01. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: TOR moved -0.91 runs while ATL moved +0.64, changing the projected margin by -1.54 runs. NRFI probability rose +6.8%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chris Sale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nathan Lukes, Ernie Clement, Ozzie Albies, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw, Eli White because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
